en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a European city with cobblestones and people in early‑20th‑century clothing. On the right stands a large, richly decorated neo‑Renaissance/Baroque palace‑like building with statues, gables and pilasters. To the left are smaller two‑storey townhouses with shopfronts and striped awnings. Various shop signs in German hang above the windows. A sign reading "APO…" (likely Apotheke, pharmacy) projects into the street on the far right. Handcarts and pedestrians populate the square in front of the grand building.
